caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental design featuring symmetrical, scroll-like patterns rendered in shades of brown and black. The central element resembles a stylized leaf or acanthus motif, flanked on both sides by large, upward curling spirals. Directly beneath the leaf motif, two horizontal, mirrored scrolls extend outward and curve upward, each terminating in a small, branching floral or leafy figure. Additional scroll patterns are present at the bottom, oriented horizontally. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, with no other objects or embellishments. The artist's name, "A.L. Davison," is inscribed in small letters below the design.
title: Section of Cast Iron Balcony
